description: Fires mostly in mid/late-game positions where the player to move is winning, strongest when the win runs through column 1: an immediate win in column 1, or my threat cells stacked just above column 1's landing cell. Weaker firing for other decisive wins (immediate win plus a second threat, stacked threats elsewhere). Early-game threats, a single col-1 threat, and mirrored (column 5) patterns do not fire.
effect: Pushes the model toward column 1: forcing it high raised column 1 by +0.17 to +0.71 probability on three positions; zeroing it at top activations lowers column 1 by about 0.05-0.11.
notes: Best dev F1 0.318 (P 0.21, R 0.71, AUROC 0.81), simulation share 0.64 (a col-1-only level reached 0.88 but F1 0.21). Minimal pairs: mirror test cuts activation ~10x when the threat is in col 1; stacked col-1 threats fire, col-5 ones do not. But many winning positions without col-1 involvement also fire and many matching patterns do not: a mixture of a 'col 1 wins' feature and a generic 'I am winning' value signal. Synthesis max 22.8 < dev max 29.1.
